top_signals.summary: The stablecoin bill signed into law last year is scheduled to go into effect in January 2027, potentially without finalized regulations from US government agencies.

top_signals.title: US Treasury seeks public comment on GENIUS Act stablecoin rules
top_signals.summary: Under the law, entities generally cannot issue payment stablecoins in the U.S. without obtaining an appropriate federal or state license.
